defects.F2: one qualified + one incomplete Invocation reported SELECTED_UNIQUE with 'no unresolved alternative exists'
defects.F3: the adapter read the DSH page after the qualifier returned, with no second relevant-basis check
defects.F4: qualifyAttempt captured ONE store head for the whole pass and each invocation rechecked only against it

correction.selection: src/composition/attributed_preview.ts selectInvocation — SELECTED_UNIQUE requires that NO other invocation exists at all (qualified.length === 1 && all.length === 1); otherwise AMBIGUOUS_REQUIRES_SELECTION; a requested qualified invocation is SELECTED_REQUESTED and its detail names the remaining unresolved invocations
correction.postReadRecheck: the store head and this Invocation's durable event-id sequence are captured before readSelectedSession and compared after; a relevant change yields qualificationState RACED with no admitted events, and the loop does not retry
correction.aggregateCurrentness: the qualifier's per-invocation recheck now also covers the cross-Attempt creator claim set (foreignCreatorsAfter), so a conflict committed during the read is caught
correction.detailSurfacing: the selected===null branch now returns the selection's own detail, so the unresolved-invocation list is visible to the consumer

evidence.observed: headAfterRead and relevantChangedDuringRead are present between the read and the invariant check
the qualifier still captures one basis at the start of the pass, and each invocation rechecks against it; the recheck basis now also includes the cross-Attempt creator set

expectedInvariant: an automatic unique selection may occur only when the whole relevant Invocation set justifies it; a conflict committed during a read must not be admitted as current attribution
remainingUncertainty: the recheck is a bounded optimistic read-check, not a distributed transaction: a change committed after the recheck and before the response is still possible, and is reported as the honest limit rather than hidden
